user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking where check-in and check-out are the same date to be rejected so that same-day bookings are not allowed.

positive.title: Successfully reject booking with same check-in and check-out date
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest.
Select a check-out date that is the same as the check-in date.
positive.expected_result: The system rejects the booking and displays a message indicating that same-day bookings are not allowed.

negative.title: Attempt to book with valid check-in and check-out dates
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest.
Select a check-out date that is after the check-in date.
negative.expected_result: The system accepts the booking and confirms the reservation.

edge.title: Edge case with maximum number of allowed days
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest.
Select the maximum allowable check-out date (e.g., one year later).
edge.expected_result: The system accepts the booking and confirms the reservation.
